text_block_list.text:
A majestic run displayed at the Japan Cup. 
Looking to ride this momentum into the 
Arima Kinen, none other than Maruzensky 
will also be entering the fray.

Harboring a thread of sentiment toward 
her, Symboli Rudolf let a quiet fighting 
spirit blaze within.

The next generation was coming into its 
own. Thanks in part to that, Symboli 
Rudolf carried a much gentler demeanor 
than before.

They want her to run just as she is right 
now. Hearing that wish from Air Groove and 
the others, she decided to forget all her 
titles and just run in the Arima Kinen.
